label: Outbound link clicks
description: Sends an event with the destination's host name when a visitor follows a link to another website.
code: // Sends an event when someone follows a link to another website. Only the
// destination's host name is sent, never the full address.
const link = event.target instanceof Element ? event.target.closest('a[href]') : null;

label: Form submissions
description: Sends an event when a matching form is submitted. Field values are never read.
code: // Sends an event when a matching form is submitted. Field values are never
// read. Mark forms with data-track-form="newsletter", or change the selector.
const form = event.target instanceof HTMLFormElement ? event.target : null;
